name: qf_alarm
character: A lab alarm in a small hard room: a two-tone klaxon at 520 and 700 Hz that keeps going while the first minute of the story happens, with the 50 Hz hum of the building under it, both fading as the Hero leaves.
note: The klaxon is a pulse train with ten harmonics at 520 Hz and a glide to 700 Hz at 1.7 cycles a second; the hum is the 50 Hz mains and its harmonics. ESTIMATE: alarm notes and the hum level are starting values; no recording of an alarm was analysed
